featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience with Vijay Sales. I purchased a Godrej AC from their store and was told that installation would be done within 48 hours. However, the technicians came after 3 days.
When they arrived, it was already late at night and they had not informed us beforehand about any requirements like a socket or proper wiring. They just installed the AC in a hurry and left without completing the proper wiring.
They charged us ₹3600 for installation but did not finish the work properly. After leaving, they told us to call an electrician ourselves to complete the remaining work. Now the electrician is asking for another ₹2000. This is very disappointing because we paid so much money expecting proper service. Half the work was done, and the rest we have to arrange ourselves. It wasted our time, money, and energy. Very poor service from Vijay Sales and the Godrej installation team. I am extremely upset with this experience and would not recommend this service to others.

featured_reviews.name: Asim Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Big Thank You to Bombay Audio – Exceptional Expertise in High-End AV Repairs

After being advised by Anthem and their local distributor that my Anthem MRX 520 amplifier could not be repaired due to unavailable parts, I was extremely disappointed.

Thankfully, Bombay Audio supported me with a level of technical expertise that is increasingly rare in the high-end audio industry.

Bombay Audio successfully repaired my amplifier and I am absolutely delighted to be able to use it again and have it fully operational in my system.

Their knowledge and willingness to take on complex repairs truly set them apart. If you are considering purchasing, servicing, or repairing high-end audio or AV equipment, I would strongly recommend that you consider Bombay Audio.

Based on this excellent experience, I will also be engaging them to assess and repair an older Pioneer plasma TV. It is reassuring to know there is a company that genuinely supports customers and the longevity of premium equipment.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Kumar Suresh
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently purchased Genelec 8030CP high end speaker pair from Bombay Audio. Infact, the decision to go for this model was assisted by Ajay himself, the Owner of Bombay Audio. I am really happy with this purchase, as after getting this product I do appreciate and understand that this is exactly what I was looking for. Hats-off to Ajay for understanding my requirements and suggesting this. Regarding the unit, its brand new and in flawless condition. Genelec 8030CP is the perfect Studio monitors for anyone looking for a near field listening experience (like on Desktops or similar compact set-ups), without compromising on anything on the tonality or base response. The best part is for my use case this speaker set -up does not lack anything on bass response and does not make us crave for an additional Sub woofer. The various dip switches and sensitivity settings helps to tune the frequency and bass response to match our needs and preferences. The overall tonality is tilted towards neutral, helping to match this with various dac/amps. Overall its a great product and superb experience in purchasing products from Bombay Audio. Highly recommended for any audiophile.
